svg.aria-label: Three research questions with schematic model sketches. Working memory: why does it hold so little, a fixed number of slots or a shared resource? Sketched as two precision-versus-set-size curves, a slot model with a kink at k items and a smooth resource model. Attention: how is a limited capacity allocated across competing inputs? Sketched as one fixed-width capacity bar split into one, two and four shares. Decision: how does a choice emerge from noisy evidence? Sketched as noisy accumulation paths rising from a start point until one of two bounds is reached.
svg.title: Three questions, three model sketches
svg.text: Why does it hold so little — a fixed
number of slots, or a shared resource?
How is a limited capacity allocated
How does a choice emerge from
evidence accumulates over time → first bound reached is the choice
Schematic illustrations of the models, not data.
